meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 接入后,NanoClaw 以副设备方式绑定你手机上的 Signal 号码并收发消息。你的助手通过 Note to Self 与你对话,支持 Markdown、引用回复、DM 输入指示;语音只给占位符。
howto.when: 当你想让助手接入 Signal(例如在 /setup 流程中加这个渠道,或用 /init-first-agent 接线)时,该技能会接管安装、设备链接与账号绑定。

say.text: 帮我把 Signal 加到助手,用设备链接扫码绑定
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并打印链接二维码

say.text: 查一下最近的 Signal 会话,把那行接给某个代理组
say.note: 查 messaging_groups 后创建接线

say.text: 给这个 Signal 用户授权,并设为 owner
say.note: 创建用户、授予角色并加入代理组

howto.what_en: Once installed, NanoClaw links to your existing Signal number as a secondary device via signal-cli and sends/receives there. Your assistant reaches you through Note to Self; Markdown, quoted replies and DM typing indicators work.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add a Signal channel to your assistant (for example during /setup or wired later with /init-first-agent), covering install, device-link and account binding.

say_en.text: Add the Signal channel to my assistant via device-link
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and prints a QR link

say_en.text: Show recent Signal chats and wire one to an agent group
say_en.note: Queries messaging_groups, then creates the wiring

say_en.text: Grant this Signal user access and make them owner
say_en.note: Creates the user, grants role, adds to group
